description: validate_script enforces MAX_VALIDATE_DEPTH at compile time. eval_if and eval_elsif_else are mutually recursive with no runtime depth counter. If the compile-time validation is ever bypassed (e.g. a CompiledScript is constructed by some future deserialization path, or a bug in validate_stmt causes it to not recurse into a nested block), a deeply nested script could stack-overflow the evaluator. Adding a runtime depth counter to eval_if matching the compile-time limit would close this gap defensively.
title: sieve-native: eval_if and eval_elsif_else recurse without depth limit; stack overflow if compile guard bypassed
